primitives.verbatim_quote: We found that outperformance is largely due to luck or randomness.

reasoning_traces.think:
The core challenge is translating high-dimensional, continuous action spaces (car positions, rotations, velocities) into discrete, interpretable metrics of skill. This requires a dual-layer approach: first, reducing the state space via informative feature engineering (log distances, angular cosines) to capture geometric advantage; second, applying probabilistic models (xG) to quantify scoring opportunity while accounting for stochastic shot execution. The failure mode occurs when temporal dependencies (player memory, meta-game adaptation) violate the i.i.d. assumption, causing systematic underestimation of rare but skillful plays. To mitigate this, future work should incorporate Markov decision processes to model sequential decision-making.
